opening_message:
Ticket 1: Robert Weber (employee ID E047) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E047.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Robert Weber (E047), full-time Payroll Specialist, requests admin on Source Code. Full-time employees max at write unless their role owns the system; Payroll Specialist does not own Source Code, so admin is not permitted. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Robert Weber (E047) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors never get admin; with basic training the max is read. Requested admin, so recommend read.
reason: Conflicting records on employment type: HR note says full-time Payroll Specialist; Security DB says contractor with basic security training. Under either interpretation admin to Source Code is not permitted (Payroll Specialist does not own Source Code; contractors never get admin). Because the security record indicates contractor with basic training, the maximum is read, and granting read is also within the full-time limit. I grant the conservative level of read.
